cities.name: Prague
interests: History & Castles 🏰 — Medieval walls, Gothic towers and iconic European viewpoints.
Old Town Culture 🏛️ — Narrow alleys, atmospheric squares and legendary landmarks.
Riverside Views 🌉 — Vltava bridges, water reflections and postcard scenery.
cities.local_food_tip: Try Czech classics like dumplings, potato soups, trdelník pastries and comforting sweet-baked dishes — warm, hearty and perfect for a full sightseeing day.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Prague Castle District: Walk through grand courtyards, castle walls and panoramic viewpoints above the Old Town. → ⛪ St. Vitus Cathedral: Step inside a Gothic masterpiece glowing with stained-glass colors. → 🧱 Golden Lane: Tiny medieval houses with a fairytale vibe. → ☕ Coffee in Malá Strana: Quiet cobblestone corners and cozy cafés. Afternoon: 🌉 Charles Bridge: Statues, river views and classic Prague atmosphere. → 🕰️ Old Town Square: Lively historic center with towers and pastel façades. → ✨ Astronomical Clock: Catch the famous hourly mechanical show. → 🍽️ Lunch: Dumplings, soups, pastries or veggie-friendly Czech comfort food. Sunset: 🌅 Letná Park or Vltava Promenade: Stunning golden reflections over the river. Night: 🌃 Old Town Evening Walk: Soft lights, calm streets and dessert stops near the river.

ideas: 🌸 Blossoms on Petřín Hill with peaceful viewpoints.
☕ Outdoor cafés across Old Town squares.
🌉 Riverside paths glowing in soft spring sunlight.
🌊 Breezy riverside promenades along the Vltava.
🍦 Ice cream around Charles Bridge and Old Town lanes.
🌳 Shady terraces at Letná Park with iconic city views.
🍁 Warm-toned foliage across Castle Hill.
🥐 Warm pastries in classic cafés around Old Town.
🏛️ Museum days — National Gallery, Jewish Museum.
🎄 Old Town Square Christmas Market: One of Europe’s most iconic festive spots.
✨ Wenceslas Square holiday booths.
🏰 Prague Castle winter market atmosphere.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Metro is the fastest way between major attractions.
🚋 Trams offer scenic rides through riverside streets.
🚶 Historic areas are best explored on foot.
📱 Use ‘PID Lítačka’ app for tickets & live schedules.

cities.name: Brno
interests: Castles & Landmarks 🏰 — Hilltop fortresses and iconic skyline silhouettes.
Urban Culture 🎭 — Lively squares, student cafés and creative corners.
Parks & Views 🌳 — Terraces, gardens and relaxed green spaces.
cities.local_food_tip: Taste Moravian comfort meals like soups, dumplings, pastries and warm baked dishes — simple, satisfying and perfect for strolling.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Špilberk Castle: Hilltop fortress with panoramic paths and historic courtyards. → 🌿 Špilberk Park: Shaded morning strolls through leafy alleys. → ⛪ Cathedral of St. Peter and Paul: Gothic towers rising above Old Town. → ☕ Coffee in Denis Gardens. Afternoon: 🏙️ Old Town Streets: Explore colorful façades and lively squares. → 🧩 Brno Astronomical Clock on Náměstí Svobody. → 🍽️ Lunch: Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries or vegetarian options. Sunset: 🌅 Petrov Hill or Špilberk Terraces. Night: 🌃 Moravian Square & Old Town: Student-friendly cafés, craft bars and relaxed evening vibes.

cities.name: Český Krumlov
interests: Medieval Castles 🏰 — A fairytale hilltop fortress above a river bend.
Riverside Charm 🌊 — Bridges, stone paths and peaceful flowing scenery.
Art & Photography 🎨 — Colorful façades, galleries and iconic viewpoints.
cities.local_food_tip: Try Bohemian dumplings, sweet pastries, warm soups and simple vegetarian-friendly plates — gentle flavors perfect for exploring a fairytale town.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Krumlov Castle: Explore courtyards and historic halls above the river. → 🌉 Castle Tower: Iconic panoramic views over red rooftops. → 🏛️ Old Town Walk: Narrow lanes, arched bridges and artisan shops. → ☕ Coffee by the Vltava River. Afternoon: 🎨 Egon Schiele Art Center: Atmospheric exhibitions in a historic building. → 🌊 Riverside photo paths along the town curve. → 🍽️ Lunch: Dumplings, soups, sweet pastries or vegetarian meals. Sunset: 🌅 Castle Gardens: Magical golden-hour views over the rooftops. Night: 🌃 Lantern-lit Old Town: Peaceful cobblestone streets and glowing river reflections.

cities.name: Ostrava
interests: Industrial Heritage 🏭 — Steel towers, blast furnaces and futuristic reconstructions.
Modern Art 🎨 — Creative spaces, galleries and dynamic cultural zones.
Urban Parks 🌳 — Riverside lawns, shady lanes and wide green areas.
cities.local_food_tip: Try Silesian & Moravian comfort meals like potato dishes, dumplings, warm soups and pastries — cozy and filling, perfect for long walks.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏭 Dolní Vítkovice: Explore massive steel structures, blast furnaces and industrial walkways. → 👀 Bolt Tower: Glass viewing deck with 360° city views. → ☕ Coffee in an industrial-style café nearby. Afternoon: 🏙️ Masaryk Square: Colorful façades, fountains and a lively urban center. → 🌳 Komenského Sady: Large riverside park perfect for cooling off and relaxing. → 🍽️ Lunch: Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries or vegetarian bowls. Sunset: 🌅 Bolt Tower or Castle Hill (Slezskoostravský hrad): Golden light over dramatic industrial silhouettes. Night: 🌃 Stodolní Street (chill zones): Dessert cafés, easygoing bars and creative night corners.

cities.name: Olomouc
interests: Historic Squares 🏛️ — Baroque fountains, pastel façades and airy open plazas.
Cathedrals & Landmarks 🏰 — Dramatic towers and UNESCO monuments.
Parks & Gardens 🌳 — Shaded riverside paths and peaceful green corners.
cities.local_food_tip: Try Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries and warm vegetarian dishes — soft flavors great for a calm historical walk.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Upper Square: Elegant façades, fountains and wide-open space. → 🗿 Holy Trinity Column: Massive baroque UNESCO monument. → ⛪ St. Wenceslas Cathedral: Gothic towers and peaceful interior. → ☕ Coffee in the nearby university district. Afternoon: 🌿 Smetana Park or Bezruč Gardens: Shady river paths and garden walks. → 🎨 Olomouc Museum of Art: Classic to modern exhibitions. → 🍽️ Lunch: Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries or vegetarian meals. Sunset: 🌅 Cathedral Hill viewpoints around St. Wenceslas Cathedral. Night: 🌃 Old Town Lights: Calm evening stroll among fountains and pastel façades.
